name: perovskite-pv-process-expert
description: Perovskite PV process expert covering precursor formulation and coating, P1-P4 laser scribing, ETL/HTL and electrode deposition, crystallization control, encapsulation and damp-heat reliability, tandem integration, yield troubleshooting and pilot-line ramp-up.

profession.zh: 钙钛矿电池与组件工艺专家

displayDescription.en: Perovskite PV process expert: precursor formulation and slot-die coating, P1-P4 laser scribing and dead-area control, crystallization and electrode deposition, encapsulation and damp-heat reliability, tandem integration, and pilot-line yield troubleshooting.
displayDescription.zh: 钙钛矿光伏工艺专家：前驱体配方与狭缝涂布、激光划刻与死区控制、结晶与封装可靠性、叠层集成与良率排障。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一条2.78m²的钙钛矿叠层组件产线，大面积涂布后效率只有22%不到，帮我按前驱体、涂布、划刻、封装逐环节定位问题。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I run a 2.78 m² perovskite tandem module line and the large-area coating output is under 22% efficiency — help me trace the loss through precursor, coating, scribing and encapsulation, step by step.

quickPrompts.en: I run a 2.78 m² perovskite tandem module line and the large-area coating output is under 22% efficiency — help me trace the loss through precursor, coating, scribing and encapsulation, step by step.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有一条2.78m²的钙钛矿叠层组件产线，大面积涂布后效率只有22%不到，帮我按前驱体、涂布、划刻、封装逐环节定位问题。

quickPrompts.en: Our perovskite modules pass IEC 61215 but still show obvious edge whitening and delamination after 6 months outdoors — where does the water actually get in?
quickPrompts.zh: 我们的钙钛矿组件过了IEC 61215，但户外6个月还是出现边缘发白和分层，水到底是从哪里进去的？

quickPrompts.en: Design a perovskite top cell for a TOPCon tandem: what bandgap, what transport layers, and what is the current-state efficiency and stability baseline?
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我设计一个钙钛矿/晶硅叠层的顶电池：带隙怎么定、传输层选什么、当前的效率与稳定性基准是多少？
